r: AP (Agricultural Produce and Livestock) Markets Act
Act **No. 16** of 1966; crops, livestock and products
**Single market fee**, **registration** in place of licensing
Open auction, standard weights, recorded prices, **licensed buyers**
Notified area → Market Committee → notified market (yard)
Asia's largest chilli market; **Agri Export Zone for red chillies** in Guntur
**Subabul, Eucalyptus and Casuarina** sold to paper mills through market committees
1,656 mandis in 23 States and 4 UTs; **AP 33 markets**; each AP mandi got free software + **Rs 30 lakh**; 39-52 FPOs registered
Most e-NAM trades are within one mandi; AP: only **11 mandis** in inter-mandi trade (Rs 13.98 crore, Dec 2024)
Helped **price discovery**; payments and inter-mandi trade still lag
Makes the **whole State a single market**; private markets, e-trading, unified licence – pushes **inter-mandi and inter-State** trade
AP = **first State** with an e-marketing platform linking its farmers to traders across India (APFEVCL SPV, 2021)
**CM APP** (Continuous Monitoring of Agricultural Prices and Procurement)
